name: Tokyo Electron Device Limited
summary: Tokyo Electron Device Limited, a technology trading company, engages in the sale of semiconductor products, boards and electronic components, software, and services worldwide. It offers semiconductors, such as microprocessors, DSPs, memory ICs, ASICs, FPGAs, PLDs, security applications, peripheral LSIs, image processors, telecom applications, wireless ICs, sensor ICs, AD/DAs logic ICs, clock/timing ICs, analog ICs/power supply ICs, inductors/discrete devices, telecom/network applications, RF/microwave applications, and optical devices.
